title: Execution Observability must not refuse a correct check: tell a real source change from a turn that changed nothing, automatically
outcome: During ordinary work, a clean registered check on the current source earns an evaluation, whatever turns come before, around or after it; a real source change after the check is still refused. No empty turns, silence or special manual procedure are needed.
acceptance: The actual source of both window refusals of 2026-11-04 (TermAl unadmitted 5f332fbf on w-c486276cc7a2; Engram position 243 on w-e95c35f8ed70) is established from source and recorded on this item, separating what was read or run from what is inferred, and each cause is removed in the product: no workaround, empty turns, silence, manual ordering or new procedure for agents.

Regression tests against a real Engram show an accepted evaluation and a completed done for a clean registered check, on criteria bound or not bound to a check kind, when: it is the first close of a named root; the claim is recovered or the root newly named; the host could not place its command; an ordinary mail-woken turn overlaps the previous close; later turns of the holder close before or during the evaluator's run with no change; the turn edited, committed and then checked; the turn checked, failed, fixed and checked again.

Regression tests against a real Engram show refusal for: a real source change after the check in the same turn, in a later turn, and during the evaluator's run; a cached old result delivered after a real change; a check on a dirty tree or on another commit. A real difference at decision time, a dirty root or another commit, is refused at evaluation and at done, whether or not any turn report arrived; asserted evidence cannot borrow Git provenance from a declared revision's text.

An edit after the check that is reverted to the checked commit before a decision is accepted, measured or not, and is pinned by a test; the documentation states that equal endpoints show the final input was checked and say nothing about the interval between them.

One simple end-to-end run of ordinary work passes on Linux and on Windows against a real Engram on a disposable store: claim, name, edit, commit and check in one turn with the holder's turn order as it naturally falls, further ordinary turns, independent evaluation, done, with no manual step beyond those.
No stored evaluation, verification or seal is rewritten, recomputed, relabelled, invalidated, deleted or re-run.

completion.summary: Delivered real Engram ordinary-work regression matrix on Linux and Windows, fixed Windows live-selector argv and durable passing provenance, and landed as N24. All six criteria evidenced in linked consolidation; independent evaluation remains non-blocking under current Greg policy. Original failed runs and delivery refusals unchanged, no native credit fabricated. Two deferred Lows remain separate. Root cleanup follows; evidence needed by open joint adapter audit retained under w-c07c note92a63ed8265e49ce85ac14acb7128b37.
